name: Neural Volumetric Mesh Generator (NVMG) Evaluation & Regularization
definition: Regularization loss terms used in ablation: surface term, robust projection term, orientation term, and smooth term. The orientation term penalizes volumes below a minimal threshold to prevent thin structures from vanishing and promotes physical feasibility.
summary: NVMG Evaluation and Regularization ensures geometric validity of tetrahedral meshes by combining four specific loss terms and using aspect ratio and oriented volume signs for quality assessment.
